enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping quietly after a late aged-care shift, catching up on rest with the light off and fan on low
enriched_activities.desc: Lies down on bed. Pulls blanket over body. Turns off light. Turns on fan to low setting. Closes eyes. Adjusts pillow under head. Turns onto side. Remains asleep. Breathes steadily. Occasionally shifts position. Pulls blanket up. Continues sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing face, brushing teeth and getting dressed for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Wakes up. Sits up on bed. Swings legs over side. Stands up. Walks to bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Turns on tap. Cups water in hands. Splashes water on face. Picks up soap. Rubs soap on face. Rinses face with water. Turns off tap. Picks up towel. Wipes face. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth with water. Spits into sink. Turns off tap. Picks up clothes. Puts on shirt. Puts on pants. Puts on socks. Turns off bathroom light. Walks out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle, making tea and eating a flexitarian breakfast while reading written reminders for the week
enriched_activities.desc: Enters kitchen. Turns on kitchen light. Picks up kettle. Fills kettle with water. Places kettle on base. Presses switch to boil. Opens cupboard. Takes out mug. Takes out tea bag. Places tea bag in mug. Waits for kettle to boil. Pours hot water into mug. Removes tea bag. Opens fridge. Takes out bread. Places bread in toaster. Presses toaster lever. Waits for toast. Takes out plate. Butters toast. Sits at table. Eats breakfast. Reads written reminders. Sips tea. Finishes eating. Stands up. Rinses plate. Places plate in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and loading the washing machine with a load of laundry
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Takes off clothes. Turns on shower. Adjusts temperature. Steps into shower. Wets body. Applies soap. Rinses. Turns off shower. Steps out. Picks up towel. Dries body. Wraps towel around waist. Picks up laundry basket. Opens washing machine door. Puts clothes into washing machine. Adds detergent. Closes door. Sets cycle. Presses start.

enriched_activities.activity: Sitting at the desk under the desk lamp, typing up placement notes on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bedroom. Turns on desk lamp. Sits on chair. Turns on computer. Opens placement notes file. Types notes. Pauses. Saves file. Continues typing. Checks time on monitor. Types more notes. Saves file again.

enriched_activities.activity: Making another pot of tea and having a light snack, checking the weekly budget notes
enriched_activities.desc: Enters kitchen. Fills kettle with water. Places kettle on base. Presses switch to boil. Opens cupboard. Takes out mug. Takes out tea bag. Places tea bag in mug. Waits for kettle to boil. Pours hot water into mug. Removes tea bag. Opens cupboard. Takes out snack. Eats snack. Opens notebook with budget notes. Reads budget notes. Makes notes with pen. Sips tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing written course readings and unit instructions on the monitor, highlighting key points
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Turns on monitor. Opens course readings document. Reads text. Picks up highlighter. Highlights key points. Turns page. Continues reading. Highlights more key points. Scrolls down. Reads unit instructions. Highlights important dates. Closes document.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a simple flexitarian lunch of rice and vegetables with the induction cooker and rice cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Enters kitchen. Washes rice. Puts rice in rice cooker. Adds water. Turns on rice cooker. Washes vegetables. Chops vegetables. Turns on induction cooker. Adds oil to pan. Adds vegetables to pan. Stir-fries vegetables. Adds spices. Stirs. Turns off induction cooker. Serves rice and vegetables onto plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Moving the laundry into the clothes dryer and tidying the bathroom
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bathroom. Opens washing machine. Takes out clothes. Puts clothes in dryer. Closes dryer door. Sets dryer. Presses start. Wipes bathroom counter. Wipes sink. Tidies toiletries.

enriched_activities.activity: Volunteering at the animal shelter, helping with feeding, cleaning and walking the animals
enriched_activities.desc: Arrives at animal shelter. Signs in. Puts on apron. Fills food bowls. Places bowls in cages. Refills water bowls. Picks up cleaning supplies. Cleans cages. Sweeps floor. Takes dogs for walks. Returns dogs to cages. Pets cats. Cleans litter boxes. Refills food and water for cats. Washes hands. Signs out.

enriched_activities.activity: Travelling home by train and bus
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to train station. Waits on platform. Boards train. Sits down. Rides train. Gets off at station. Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Sits down. Rides bus. Gets off at stop. Walks home. Enters home.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing a flexitarian dinner with vegetables and lentils, drinking tea instead of alcohol
enriched_activities.desc: Enters kitchen. Washes vegetables. Chops vegetables. Rinses lentils. Puts lentils in pot. Adds water. Turns on stove. Boils lentils. Adds vegetables. Stirs. Adds spices. Turns down heat. Fills kettle with water. Boils kettle. Pours water into mug. Adds tea bag. Stirs tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner and washing up the dishes
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at table. Eats dinner. Drinks tea. Finishes eating. Stands up. Picks up plates. Scrapes food into bin. Rinses plates. Loads dishwasher. Adds detergent. Closes dishwasher. Presses start. Wipes table.

enriched_activities.activity: Sending text messages to family in China and looking at the photo of the family dog
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bedroom. Sits on bed. Picks up phone. Unlocks phone. Opens messaging app. Selects family contact. Types message: 'Hi, how are you?' Sends message. Receives reply. Reads reply. Types reply: 'I am fine.' Sends reply. Opens photo gallery. Finds photo of family dog. Looks at photo. Zooms in on photo. Closes photo gallery.

enriched_activities.activity: Drafting assignment work on the computer at the desk, with written checklists to stay on task
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Turns on computer. Opens assignment document. Reads written checklist. Types draft. Checks off item on checklist. Continues typing. Saves document. Reads next checklist item. Types more. Saves again.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening wash and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Turns on tap. Washes face. Turns off tap. Dries face. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Spits. Turns off tap. Takes off clothes. Puts on pajamas. Turns off bathroom light. Leaves bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Writing out the coming week's shift roster, rent and bill amounts in a notebook and setting phone reminders
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Opens notebook. Picks up pen. Writes shift roster. Writes rent amount. Writes bill amounts. Picks up phone. Opens calendar app. Sets reminders for shifts. Sets reminders for bill due dates. Saves reminders. Puts down phone. Closes notebook.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading quietly in bed with a cup of tea
enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Picks up book. Opens book. Reads. Sips tea from cup. Turns page. Continues reading. Sips tea. Turns page. Finishes reading. Closes book. Places book on nightstand. Places cup on nightstand.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, with the light off and fan on low for quiet rest
enriched_activities.desc: Turns off light. Turns on fan to low setting. Lies down. Pulls blanket up. Closes eyes. Remains asleep. Breathes steadily. Occasionally shifts position. Continues sleeping.
